_comment: Per-model headers (D182). Copy an entry into ~/.yi/catalog/<provider>.json and yi
sends its `headers` on every request for that (provider, id).
The file overlays the bundled catalog by (provider, id): the bundle is the floor, a
missing or unreadable file changes nothing, `yi catalog` prints its age, and a
background refresh may rewrite it (set catalog.enabled: false to hand-hold a file).
A name here REPLACES the adapter's own header of that name, matched
case-insensitively -- it does not ride beside it. That is what makes `authorization`
and `x-api-key` retargetable, and it is also the footgun: this file already chooses
`baseUrl`, so an entry can point a request somewhere else AND set the credential it
arrives with. Treat it as you would a shell profile.
Values are literal strings; yi does no expansion, so there is no ${ENV_VAR} form.
Shape and field names are the bundle's own: {api: {id: Model}}.

headers._: Auth retarget: the gateway wants a bearer, so `authorization` is added and
headers.__: `x-api-key` is blanked -- the adapter would otherwise send both.

headers._: The OpenAI-style paths build only `authorization`; anything else is additive.
